[SWS_PHM_00241] Supervisions on Start of Process
⌈
On start of the
process for which a Supervision (Alive Supervision, Deadline Supervision
and/or Logical Supervision) is configured in the new Function Group State,
the Supervision (Alive Supervision, Deadline Supervision and/or Logi-
cal Supervision) shall be performed as per the configured Supervision parameter
values in the Supervision Mode corresponding to new Function Group State.
⌋
